programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: Home Fires Burning
programme.desc: Slice of Americana about the impact of WWII on a Southern hamlet. Barnard Hughes. Pastine: Sada Thompson. Rosh: Robert Prosky. Henry: Bill Pullman. Francine: Elizabeth Berridge. Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: The Cookie Mobster
programme.desc: A young mob member goes into the Witness Protection Program and settles into a quiet suburban village, where he falls for a local woman and gets involved with cookie-making fund-raising for her daughter's scout troop while dodging his former associates who have tracked him down.

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Return to Sender
programme.desc: When a weathered old envelope appears in the mailbox of Meg's new apartment marked Return to Sender, she joins the building manager Ollie along with podcaster Ellen and partner Pete to find out who sent this mysterious love letter.

programme.title: Bound & Babysitting
programme.desc: A couple need a babysitter so they can go on a much-needed romantic getaway, so they enlist the help of two friends who have been enemies since college in hopes that they realize how much they have in common.

programme.title: Oliver's Ghost
programme.desc: A young boy (Nicholas Stargel) befriends a ghost (Martin Mull) living in the attic of his family's new house in a small town. After several angry outbursts from the ghost, the boy tries to get to the bottom of what's plaguing him. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Bound by a Secret
programme.desc: Dying actress Jane (Leslie Ann Warren) returns to her hometown to spend her final days with her best friend, Ida Mae (Meredith Baxter). Their respite hits a snag, though, when Jane decides to reveal that she's the biological mother of Ida Mae's daughter (Bridget Ann White). Timothy Bottoms also stars. Directed by David S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Soda Springs
programme.desc: A man named Eden finds redemption during a trip back to his hometown.

programme.title: Undercover Bridesmaid
programme.desc: A security agent goes undercover as a bridesmaid in order to protect a bride-to-be who's been receiving threatening letters leading up to her nuptials. As the agent works the case, she also forms a bond with a groomsman and learns a lesson about forgiveness.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Romance develops when a cynical divorce mediator has to take care of a client's dog.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Sentimental tale of a proud widow (Ann-Margret) whose deteriorating sight impels her to take in a drifter (Matthew Settle) and his precocious daughter (Shailene Woodley). Gary Sandy, Hunter Tylo. Jan Kyles: Rebecca McFarland. Dave Jeeters: Sean O'Bryan. Sheriff Gorman: Christopher Murray.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: A perfectionist adman (Chad Lowe) becomes a surrogate dad when the death of his sister lands his rambunctious nephew (K'Sun Ray) in his care. George Segal. Holly: Marin Hinkle.

programme.desc: Rachel, a NYC appraiser is sent to a small town to buy out a library so her client can build a resort. She meets Jake, a local writer who tries to convince her how important the library is to the small community but the arrival of his niece and nephew complicate his efforts.

programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.desc: Slice of Americana about the impact of WWII on a Southern hamlet. Barnard Hughes. Pastine: Sada Thompson. Rosh: Robert Prosky. Henry: Bill Pullman. Francine: Elizabeth Berridge. Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: The Nanny Express
programme.desc: A spunky nanny (Vanessa Marcil) tries to win over her rebellious charges, who are coping with the death of their mother. Romance soon blooms between the nanny and the kids' father (Brennan Elliott), but the relationship could stall if the kids object. Dean Stockwell and Stacy Keach also star.

programme.title: How Not to Propose
programme.desc: A guy plans a romantic weekend getaway to pop the question to his longtime love, but things hit a hitch.

programme.title: Sweet Surrender
programme.desc: After spending years in the military, a young man returns to his hometown to take over operation of his ailing grandmother's bed-and-breakfast, where he must contend with an old flame who's scheming to get the property turned into a mall.

programme.title: Mechanics of Love
programme.desc: Mattie, a tech entrepreneur who is home for her sisters wedding runs into Jake, a childhood friend who complicates her life.

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: In this romantic tearjerker, an angst-ridden doctor (Lisa Hartman Black) returns home to attend a high-school reunion---and to mend fences with loved ones she left behind. Helen: Rue McClanahan. Gus: Dale Midkiff. Nelson: Larry Manetti.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: This Magic Moment
programme.desc: An aspiring screenwriter pretends to date a starlet who's trying to make her ex jealous. As the duo keep up their ruse, the lines between fact and fiction begin to blur and romantic entanglements ensue.

programme.title: Captains Courageous
programme.desc: Rudyard Kipling's tale about a spoiled heir (Kenny Vadas) who learns the value of friendship and work when he's rescued at sea by fishermen and forced to earn his keep. Capt. Troop: Robert Urich. Dan: Kaj-Erik Eriksen. Wade: Robert Wisden. Mrs. Troop: Sandra Nelson. Michael Anderson directed.

programme.title: Undercover Bridesmaid
programme.desc: A security agent goes undercover as a bridesmaid in order to protect a bride-to-be who's been receiving threatening letters leading up to her nuptials. As the agent works the case, she also forms a bond with a groomsman and learns a lesson about forgiveness.

programme.title: My Son Went Quiet
programme.desc: After the death of his wife, a South Asian father and his son begin seeing a shadow around the walls of their home.

programme.title: Corner Gas

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Hank is unaffected by the mosquitoes; Lacey contributes to the time capsule; Oscar goes back to work at Corner Gas.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash's decisions lead to conflict with the new chief of emergency medicine; Mags struggles to save a patient who thinks the system gave up on her; June has trouble with her new roommate, and gets a work proposal from Novak; Theo has trouble adapting.

programme.title: H.appiness
programme.desc: An app designed to bring its users happiness helps a man build the perfect life, which he ends up destroying when he learns the app is faulty.

programme.title: The New Corporation: The Unfortunately Necessary Sequel
programme.desc: Filmmakers Joel Bakan and Jennifer Abbott examine the influence of corporations on every aspect of modern society.

programme.title: The Queen of My Dreams
programme.desc: Pakistani Muslim Mariam and her Canadian-born daughter Azra come of age in two different eras against the backdrop of a shared obsession with Bollywood fantasy.

programme.title: The Taste of Things
programme.desc: Cook Eugenie and her boss Dodin grow fond of one another over 20 years, and their romance gives rise to dishes that impress even the world's most illustrious chefs. When Dodin is faced with Eugenie's reluctance to commit, he begins to cook for her.

programme.title: Coming Home
programme.desc: Going behind the scenes of the production of the Crave Original drama series "Little Bird," and the groundbreaking movement for Indigenous narrative sovereignty as experienced by the series' creatives, crew and Sixties Scoop advisors.

programme.title: Triumph: Rock & Roll Machine
programme.desc: The story of underdog Canadian rock band Triumph, which rose to stardom in the 1970s and '80s only to disappear at the height of its fame.

programme.title: The Pod Generation
programme.desc: In the not-so-distant future, amid a society madly in love with technology, tech giant Pegazus offers couples the opportunity to share their pregnancies via detachable artificial wombs or pods. Rachel and Alvy's wild ride to parenthood begins.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead.

programme.title: And Just Like That...
programme.desc: Old pals Carrie, Miranda, and Charlotte transition from the friendship they had in their 30s to a more complicated reality of life and friendship in their 50s.

programme.title: In the Lost Lands
programme.desc: A witch travels to the Lost Lands in search of a magical power that allows a person to transform into a werewolf.

programme.title: Greedy People
programme.desc: Residents of a small island town navigate a murder and the discovery of a million dollars, a series of increasingly bad decisions upend the once peaceful community.

programme.title: The G
programme.desc: Ann and her husband are forced into an elder care facility by a shady legal guardian who wants their money. Trapped in a corrupt and terrifying system, Ann starts to show her true mettle as she seeks revenge against the people who ruined her life.

programme.title: House of Gucci
programme.desc: When Patrizia Reggiani, an outsider from humble beginnings, marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a reckless spiral of betrayal, decadence, revenge -- and ultimately murder.

programme.title: H.appiness
programme.desc: An app designed to bring its users happiness helps a man build the perfect life, which he ends up destroying when he learns the app is faulty.

programme.title: Gem & Shaz
programme.desc: Two Asian Canadian teenage girls are given one hour at the school dance by their strict immigrant parents and are determined to make the most of it.

programme.title: I Am: Joe Frazier
programme.desc: Celebrating the rise of a humble but driven boxing perfectionist who triumphantly emerged from Muhammad Ali's long shadow to become the Heavyweight Champion of the World and redefined greatness in his own image.

programme.title: Stonehenge Apocalypse
programme.desc: Archaeologists digging near Stonehenge accidentally activate an ancient piece of machinery underneath the bedrock that could end the world.

programme.title: Kina & Yuk
programme.desc: Two foxes are preparing to become parents for the first time while global warming is altering the rules for everyone.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson: Black + White
programme.desc: A celebration of the life and career of Oscar Peterson, one of Canada's greatest jazz musicians and a master pianist.

programme.title: Behemoth
programme.desc: After an earthquake wakes a giant creature trapped in a mountain, residents have to find a way to kill it before it destroys the entire town.

programme.title: Super Storm
programme.desc: A high-school student creates a science project that holds the key to saving the Earth from devastating cyclones.

programme.title: Metal Shifters
programme.desc: After a meteorite crashes to Earth, a bacteria is released that kills humans on contact. When the bacteria latches on to an iron statue, it brings the statue to life to send it on a destructive rampage.

programme.title: Polar Storm
programme.desc: A scientist must save the day when violent storms threaten Earth's magnetic poles.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with a powerful faction of Transformers known as the Maximals to save Earth.

programme.title: The Last Showgirl
programme.desc: A seasoned showgirl must plan for her future when her show abruptly closes after a 30-year run.

programme.title: Daddio

programme.title: Bagman

programme.title: Kraven the Hunter

programme.title: The Blind

programme.title: Toxic Skies
programme.desc: A doctor must find a cure for a viral epidemic that is spreading through vapors from jets.

programme.title: Ailey
programme.desc: Filmmaker Jamila Wignot examines the life of visionary dancer and choreographer Alvin Ailey.

programme.title: Paddington in Peru
programme.desc: Paddington and the Brown family stumble across a legendary treasure as they embark on a thrilling quest through the rainforests of the Amazon to find his beloved aunt.

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: Cat is a solitary animal, but as its home is devastated by a great flood, he finds refuge on a boat populated by various species, and will have to team up with them despite their differences.

programme.title: My Penguin Friend
programme.desc: A heartbroken fisherman finds a penguin drifting alone in the ocean, drenched in oil from a spill. He not only rescues the sea creature, but takes it under his wing, finding a sense of joy for the first time in years.

programme.title: The Addams Family 2

programme.title: Sinners

programme.title: The Plus One

programme.title: Dark Side of Reality TV

programme.title: Young Werther

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: Period action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Ray Winstone, Cate Blanchett and Shia LaBeouf. Nevada in the late 1950s: intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones finds himself up to his neck in trouble again when he encounters Irina Spalko and a gang of Soviet agents at a military base in the desert. However, this is only the start of a series of adventures that will take Indy deep into the Amazon jungle in search of a mysterious crystal skull.

programme.title: The Wild Robot
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Lupita Nyong'o, Kit Connor and Pedro Pascal. Washed up on the shore of an island, robot "Roz" learns to cope with the environment. When she encounters orphaned gosling Brightbill, Roz and wily fox Fink join forces to raise the runt.

programme.title: Wicked (Singalong Version)

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Anjelica Huston and Mai Zetterling. After the death of his parents, young Luke visits England. His grandmother, Helga, has warned Luke about witches so he's not surprised when he discovers that their seaside hotel is hosting an English witch convention. However, the star guest at the convention is the Grand High Witch, who reveals her dastardly plan to turn the nation's children into rodents.

programme.title: Ready Player One
programme.desc: Sci-fi action thriller starring Tye Sheridan, Olivia Cooke and Mark Rylance. In 2045, society's main entertainment is an ultra-immersive virtual reality simulation called the "OASIS". Its late creator, James Halliday, has hidden an Easter egg within the game that, if unlocked, will grant ownership to the finder. Teen gamer Wade Watts is determined to win the prize, but he has lethal competition in the form of Halliday's ruthless business rival Nolan Sorrento.

programme.title: Spy Kids
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure, starring Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alexa Vega and Daryl Sabara. But when the secretive agents are posted missing in action, it's left to their bemused offspring, Carmen and Juni, to find out what their parents have been up to and to save them.
